root_causes.root_cause: snapshot_prior_verdicts() (RFC-026 D3) is implemented in storage.py but never called by the corpus reingestion pipeline before the MinIO processed/* wipe. find_prior_verdict() therefore always returns None during full re-ingestion, disabling hysteresis. Documents with max_leaf_ratio between 0.30 and 0.40 lose the +0.10 hysteresis band (PASS_HYSTERESIS_BAND) and regress from PASS to MARGINAL on byte-identical trees.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Wire snapshot_prior_verdicts() into the corpus reingestion pipeline's wipe step. The corpus-ingest and corpus-ingest-score skills both define a 'Wipe MinIO processed/' step — add a pre-wipe call to snapshot_prior_verdicts() so that find_prior_verdict() can fall back to _prior_verdicts.json. Concretely: (1) export snapshot_prior_verdicts in storage.py __all__; (2) add a call in the pipeline orchestration (either as a skill instruction for the agent to run before wipe, or as a programmatic step in any wipe utility function); (3) verify the existing find_prior_verdict fallback path (line 726-743) correctly reads the snapshot.
